title: Spring Data JPA error when selecting property value

labels.name: area/spring
labels.description: Issues relating to the Spring integration

body:
**Describe the bug**
I'm migrating an application which uses Spring Data Repostiories from Wildfly to Quarkus and encounter exceptions during the initialization phase.

The following code:

    @Query("SELECT DISTINCT code.otpsubject.id FROM OtpCodeEntity code")
    List<String> findAllOtpsubjectIds();
Causes: IllegalStateException: java.lang.String was not part of the Quarkus index

But `OtpSubject.id` is of type `String`. 
I don't exaclty understand  why I get that error. It doesn't even work if I remove `.id` from the query and change the return type to `List<OtpCodeEntity`.
That query could probably written differently but with more complicated queries that won't work.

**Expected behavior**
Same behavior as the non-quarkus spring-data-jpa (the example above works without exception).
Support for more complex queries (see: https://docs.jboss.org/hibernate/stable/entitymanager/reference/en/html/queryhql.html#queryhql-select)
Support of JPA queries like in https://docs.spring.io/spring-data/jpa/docs/current/reference/html/#jpa.query-methods.at-query
Support for all return types in https://docs.spring.io/spring-data/jpa/docs/current/reference/html/#repository-query-return-types


**Actual behavior**
`IllegalStateException: java.lang.String was not part of the Quarkus index` is thrown during initialization.

**To Reproduce**

https://github.com/renegrob/spring-data-api-issues

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Execute `./mvnw compile quarkus:dev` on the command line

Error in the console output:
```
java.lang.RuntimeException: 
java.lang.RuntimeException: io.quarkus.builder.BuildException: Build failure: Build failed due to errors
	[error]: Build step io.quarkus.spring.data.deployment.SpringDataJPAProcessor#build threw an exception: java.lang.IllegalStateException: java.lang.String was not part of the Quarkus index
```
